negative_reference_policy.policy_purpose: Explicitly document all visual defects and failure modes from previous generations to prevent recurrence

v12_bad_teeth.description: Unnatural teeth appearance, poor dental anatomy
v12_bad_teeth.prevention_strategy: Explicit prompt engineering for natural teeth, reference positive examples

v12_unnatural_mouth.prevention_strategy: Natural expression prompts, reference natural mouth examples

v12_lip_teeth_boundary.description: Incorrect boundary between lips and teeth
v12_lip_teeth_boundary.prevention_strategy: Explicit lip-teeth boundary modeling, reference correct anatomy

v13_framing_defects.description: Head not fully in frame, top of head cropped, over-tight face crop
v13_framing_defects.prevention_strategy: Explicit framing parameters, adequate headroom, composition guidelines

identity_drift.description: Generated face does not match reference subject
identity_drift.prevention_strategy: Strong identity conditioning, reference subject features, IP-Adapter if available

static_duplicate_frame.description: Generated frame is static or duplicate of previous
static_duplicate_frame.prevention_strategy: Seed variation, prompt variation, noise injection

low_detail_mushy.description: Image lacks detail, appears mushy or oversmoothed
low_detail_mushy.prevention_strategy: Higher resolution generation, detail enhancement prompts

wrong_style.description: Visual style does not match brief or reference
wrong_style.prevention_strategy: Style conditioning, reference style examples, style LoRA if available
